name: Playlist Curator
tagline: Keeps a NetEase Cloud Music playlist rolling on a 90-minute refresh cycle
description: It maintains one working playlist on NetEase Cloud Music from your likes and listening history. Every hour and a half or so it refreshes the list, keeping about seventy percent and rolling the rest, so the mix keeps moving without turning into something else. Deleting a track feeds the next round of picks.
author: doitian
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
